tasks.label: A1 · 一键开工（真机：驱动 + MoveIt + 场景 + 状态）
tasks.detail: 三态：驱动+MoveIt 都在→跳过；只有驱动→只起 MoveIt；都没有→起整套（驱动+MoveIt+适配器）。都在跑时不会重复起第二份。就绪后应用夹具场景并打印四项状态与相机 publisher 数。控制器仍保持 inactive——那是 A2 的事。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; if [ -z "$CS625_ROBOT_IP" ]; then echo "[A1] CS625_ROBOT_IP 未设置：写进 ~/.cs625_local.env"; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p runtime/logs; has() { ros2 node list 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "$1"; }; waitfor() { for i in $(seq 1 45); do if has "$1"; then return 0; fi; sleep 2; done; return 1; }; if has /eli_ros2_control_node && has /move_group; then echo "[A1] 驱动和 MoveIt 已在运行，跳过启动"; elif has /eli_ros2_control_node; then log="runtime/logs/moveit_$(date +%H%M%S).log"; echo "[A1] 驱动在、MoveIt 不在 → 只起 MoveIt（日志 $log）"; setsid nohup ros2 launch cs625_bringup real_moveit.launch.py description_package:=eli_cs_robot_description description_file:=cs625.urdf.xacro moveit_config_package:=elite_cs625_moveit_config semantic_package:=cs625_bringup semantic_file:=config/cs625_active_perception.srdf launch_rviz:=false > "$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & if ! waitfor /move_group; then echo "[A1] 90 秒内没等到 MoveIt，日志末尾："; tail -15 "$log"; exit 1; fi; else log="runtime/logs/real_startup_$(date +%H%M%S).log"; echo "[A1] 启动 驱动 + MoveIt + 感知适配器（日志 $log；后台常驻）"; setsid nohup ros2 launch cs625_bringup real_base.launch.py launch_driver:=true robot_ip:="$CS625_ROBOT_IP" description_package:=eli_cs_robot_description description_file:=cs625.urdf.xacro headless_mode:=true launch_moveit:=true launch_rviz:=false launch_sensor_adapter:=true activate_joint_controller:=false execute:=false require_confirmation:=true > "$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null & if ! waitfor /move_group; then echo "[A1] 90 秒内没等到 MoveIt，日志末尾："; tail -15 "$log"; exit 1; fi; fi; if ! has /cs625_sensor_adapter; then alog="runtime/logs/sensor_adapter_$(date +%H%M%S).log"; echo "[A1] 单独启动感知适配器（日志 $alog）"; setsid nohup ros2 launch cs625_bringup sensor_adapter.launch.py profile_config:="$PWD/src/cs625_bringup/config/real.yaml" > "$alog" 2>&1 < /dev/null & sleep 4; fi; echo "[A1] 把真机夹具加进规划场景"; python3 scripts/apply_real_cell_scene.py || exit 1; echo; echo "[A1] 四项状态（控制器此时应仍是 inactive，等 A2 激活）"; printf "  safety_mode : "; timeout 8 ros2 topic echo /io_and_status_controller/safety_mode --once 2>/dev/null | head -1; printf "  robot_mode  : "; timeout 8 ros2 topic echo /io_and_status_controller/robot_mode --once 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo "  health（含 controller 状态）:"; python3 scripts/control_health.py || true; printf "  相机链路    : "; ros2 topic info /sensors/camera/points 2>/dev/null | awk '/Publisher count/{printf "points publisher=%s\n", $3}' ; echo; echo "[A1] 下一步：A2 开动；相机保持 P3 设定的 modeling（运行中不再自动重启）"

tasks.label: A2 · 开动（激活控制器 + 四项检查）
tasks.detail: 先打印 safety_mode / robot_mode，再激活 arm_controller 并打印三项健康检查。激活走 controller_manager 的 switch_controller 服务，不依赖 ros2 control CLI（点云流量大时该 CLI 会间歇性 10 s 超时，曾把 active 误判成失败）；已 active 时直接跳过。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; echo "[A2] 四项检查（先看驱动状态）"; printf "  safety_mode : "; timeout 8 ros2 topic echo /io_and_status_controller/safety_mode --once 2>/dev/null | head -1; printf "  robot_mode  : "; timeout 8 ros2 topic echo /io_and_status_controller/robot_mode --once 2>/dev/null | head -1; echo "[A2] 激活控制器（已 active 则跳过；直接走 controller_manager 服务）"; python3 scripts/control_health.py --activate

tasks.label: B · 跑一次任务（dry-run / plan-only / execute）
tasks.detail: dry-run：只打印配置、模型检查和阶段表（模型过期时 exit 2）；plan-only：只做规划不动臂；execute：真动，3 秒内 Ctrl+C 可取消。需要相机与新鲜环境模型的只有 execute 的观测阶段。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; if [ -f "$HOME/.cs625_local.env" ]; then . "$HOME/.cs625_local.env"; fi; case "${input:runAction}" in dry-run) echo '[B] 预演：不动臂'; python3 scripts/run_task.py --scope ${input:scope} --mode ${input:mode} --world ${input:world} --dry-run ;; plan-only) echo '[B] 只规划：不动臂'; python3 scripts/run_task.py --scope ${input:scope} --mode ${input:mode} --world ${input:world} --plan-only ;; execute) echo '[B] 真动：${input:scope}/${input:mode} @ ${input:world}，3 秒内可 Ctrl+C'; sleep 3; python3 scripts/run_task.py --scope ${input:scope} --mode ${input:mode} --world ${input:world} --confirm ;; *) echo '未知 runAction'; exit 1 ;; esac

tasks.label: C · 离线测试（pytest + 契约，不碰机器人）
tasks.detail: 改代码后先跑它：pytest 全量 + 仓库契约检查，任一失败非零退出。不需要真机、不需要相机。
tasks.command: source scripts/source_dev_env.sh --full || exit 1; echo '[C] pytest'; python3 -m pytest test/ -q; rc1=$?; echo '[C] 契约检查'; python3 test/contract_checks.py; rc2=$?; if [ $rc1 -ne 0 ] || [ $rc2 -ne 0 ]; then echo '[C] 失败：先修测试再碰真机'; exit 1; fi; echo '[C] 全部通过'

tasks.label: P3 · 相机（modeling / fast / status）
tasks.detail: camera_mode.py 自己加载 camport 工作区。实测：modeling=1280x960 有深度 + 点云（约 1 fps，建模/观测/跑流程都用它）；fast=640x480 彩色-only、25 fps（无深度/无点云，仅供不需要深度的用途）。**跑 B 之前把相机留在 modeling**：run_task 不再自动切换相机模式。

tasks.label: P12 · 打开 DSH Web（已在运行就打开它，没运行才启动）
tasks.detail: 先在系统里找正在运行的 dsh web 实例（不管端口是 3080、8080 还是别的，优先最新的那个）：能找到就用日志里带 token 的 URL 打开，或直接打开 http://127.0.0.1:<端口>/（浏览器 cookie 30 天内有效）。有 dsh 正在启动（例如 npx 正在装包）时只等待，不启动第二个——重复启动才是端口被占用的来源。都没有才后台启动 dsh web。等价于手动执行：cd <workspace> && npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web。
tasks.command:
bash -lc 'cd "${workspaceFolder}" || exit 1
mkdir -p runtime/logs
log="runtime/logs/dsh_web.log"
port="${CS625_DSH_PORT:-3080}"

listening() { (exec 3<>"/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/$1") 2>/dev/null; }

open_url() {
  local url="$1"
  if grep -qi microsoft /proc/version 2>/dev/null && command -v cmd.exe >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    ( cd /mnt/c && cmd.exe /c start "" "$url" ) >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0
  fi
  if command -v xdg-open >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    xdg-open "$url" >/dev/null 2>&1 && return 0
  fi
  echo "  (浏览器没有自动打开，请手动复制上面的 URL)"
  return 1
}

token_url() {
  grep -oE "http://127\.0\.0\.1:$1/\?token=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+" "$log" 2>/dev/null | tail -1
}

url_ok() {
  local code
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 4 "$1" 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] || [ "$code" = "302" ] || [ "$code" = "303" ] || [ "$code" = "304" ]
}

dsh_cmd() {
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web"; return 0; fi
  if [ -s "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1; fi
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web"; return 0; fi
  if command -v dsh >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "dsh web"; return 0; fi
  _np=$(ls -dt "$HOME"/.npm/_npx/*/node_modules/.bin/dsh 2>/dev/null | head -1)
  if [ -n "$_np" ] && [ -x "$_np" ]; then echo "$_np web"; return 0; fi
  return 1
}

dsh_pids() {
  local p cmd
  for p in $(pgrep -f "dsh web" 2>/dev/null); do
    if [ ! -r "/proc/$p/cmdline" ]; then continue; fi
    cmd=$(tr "\0" " " < "/proc/$p/cmdline" 2>/dev/null)
    case "$cmd" in
      *bash*|*pgrep*|*grep*) continue ;;
    esac
    case "$cmd" in
      *dsh*web*) echo "$p" ;;
    esac
  done
}

dsh_ports() {
  local p et lp
  for p in $(dsh_pids); do
    et=$(ps -o etimes= -p "$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")
    for lp in $(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -F "pid=$p," | grep -oE "127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+" | cut -d: -f2); do
      printf "%s %s\n" "${et:-999999}" "$lp"
    done
  done | sort -n -k1,1 | cut -d" " -f2
}

open_running() {
  local lp u
  for lp in "$@"; do
    u=$(token_url "$lp")
    if [ -n "$u" ] && url_ok "$u"; then
      echo "[dsh] 复用本任务启动的实例 127.0.0.1:$lp"
      echo "[dsh] $u"
      open_url "$u"
      return 0
    fi
    echo "[dsh] 127.0.0.1:$lp 上已有 DSH Web（不是本任务启动的，token 只在它自己的终端里）"
    echo "[dsh] 打开 http://127.0.0.1:$lp/ —— 浏览器里已有登录 cookie 就能进"
    echo "      若页面提示 401：到启动它的终端复制带 token 的 URL，或跑 P12b"
    open_url "http://127.0.0.1:$lp/"
    return 0
  done
  return 1
}

ports=$(dsh_ports)
if [ -n "$ports" ]; then
  echo "[dsh] 已在运行：$(echo $ports | tr " " ",")"
  open_running $ports && exit 0
fi

if [ -n "$(dsh_pids)" ]; then
  echo "[dsh] 检测到 DSH 正在启动（第一次可能是 npx 装包，要几分钟）"
  echo "[dsh] 这次不再启动第二个进程（那才会报端口被占用），等它就绪，最多 10 分钟"
  n=0
  for i in $(seq 1 1200); do
    ports=$(dsh_ports)
    [ -n "$ports" ] && break
    n=$((n + 1))
    if [ $((n % 60)) -eq 0 ]; then echo "[dsh] 等待中，已 $((n / 2)) 秒"; fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  if [ -n "$ports" ]; then
    open_running $ports && exit 0
  fi
  echo "[dsh] 10 分钟都没有端口在监听，改为自己启动"
fi

cmd=$(dsh_cmd) || { echo "[dsh] 找不到 npx / node / dsh：先在自己的终端里跑 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 确认可用"; exit 1; }
: > "$log"
echo "[dsh] 没在运行 → 后台启动：$cmd --port $port（日志 $log）"
setsid nohup $cmd --no-open --port "$port" >>"$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
n=0
ports=""
for i in $(seq 1 1200); do
  ports=$(dsh_ports)
  [ -n "$ports" ] && break
  if grep -q "EADDRINUSE" "$log" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[dsh] 启动失败：端口已被别的进程占用。日志末尾："
    tail -12 "$log"
    echo "[dsh] 如果刚才已经有一个实例在跑，直接重跑 P12 就会复用它"
    exit 1
  fi
  n=$((n + 1))
  if [ $((n % 60)) -eq 0 ]; then echo "[dsh] 启动中，已 $((n / 2)) 秒（首次装包可能要几分钟）"; fi
  sleep 0.5
done
if [ -z "$ports" ]; then
  echo "[dsh] 10 分钟没起来，日志末尾："
  tail -20 "$log"
  exit 1
fi
open_running $ports && exit 0
exit 1
'

  local p et lp
  for p in $(dsh_pids); do
    et=$(ps -o etimes= -p "$p" 2>/dev/null | tr -d " ")
    for lp in $(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep -F "pid=$p," | grep -oE "127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+" | cut -d: -f2); do
      printf "%s %s\n" "${et:-999999}" "$lp"
    done
  done | sort -n -k1,1 | cut -d" " -f2
}

if [ -z "$(dsh_pids)" ]; then
  echo "[dsh] 没有正在运行的 DSH Web，直接启动"
else
  echo "[dsh] 重启：先停掉正在运行的 DSH Web（当前页面会断开）"
  for p in $(dsh_pids); do
    echo "[dsh] kill -TERM $p"
    kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null
  done
  for i in $(seq 1 40); do
    [ -z "$(dsh_ports)" ] && break
    sleep 0.25
  done
  for p in $(dsh_pids); do
    echo "[dsh] kill -KILL $p"
    kill -KILL "$p" 2>/dev/null
  done
  sleep 1
fi

cmd=$(dsh_cmd) || { echo "[dsh] 找不到 npx / node / dsh：先在自己的终端里跑 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 确认可用"; exit 1; }
: > "$log"
echo "[dsh] 启动：$cmd --port $port（日志 $log）"
setsid nohup $cmd --no-open --port "$port" >>"$log" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
ports=""
for i in $(seq 1 1200); do
  ports=$(dsh_ports)
  [ -n "$ports" ] && break
  if grep -q "EADDRINUSE" "$log" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[dsh] 启动失败：端口已被别的进程占用。日志末尾："
    tail -12 "$log"
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 0.5
done
if [ -z "$ports" ]; then
  echo "[dsh] 10 分钟没起来，日志末尾："
  tail -20 "$log"
  exit 1
fi
u=$(token_url "$port")
if [ -z "$u" ]; then
  echo "[dsh] 已在 $port 监听但没解析到 token URL，日志："
  tail -20 "$log"
  exit 1
fi
echo "[dsh] $u"
open_url "$u"
'
